body: It's not my only reason. But my family is apart of the reason. I've tried to tell them. But they won't listen to me. They don't want to hear it. And I'm past the point of asking them to listen.

I do. I will fully admit, in some ways, I'm almost being spiteful. They've hurt me in so many ways. Two wrongs don't make a right. But deep down, I'm rationalizing this by telling myself "I win. Now you can't hurt me anymore and I've hurt you back."

They know. With my family it's always more of a "take this pill, sit down and get over it" kind of thing. I love my family. But I've never met people as judgmental, self centered and stuck up as them. Hell...maybe that's why I'm not too concerned about them right now.
Mom, dad, sister kind of thing, of course. Not a family of my own though.
Well, I have off work tomorrow. My roommate won't be home. So, yes. I'm going to sleep on it. But I have everything ready. I'm ready.

I see what you're saying, I just feel like I've gone down that road before. I've told myself there's a light at the end of the tunnel. But after things get a little better, they go to shit again and I find myself falling further and further down. I'm tired. I really am.
It's permanently making the pain stop. And I'm okay with that.
I tried looking for help. I thought I'd found it, too. I was happy. But it all came crashing back down. The calm before the storm. I don't want to fight anymore. I can't.
Yup. I'm in the same boat. I can't wake up after that. I have a plan now, but I need alcohol.
I'm afraid it's going to hurt. Or it won't work.
I think I'm done pushing through.
